correctness.rationale: Columnwise matching relations V_i+T_{i-1}+T_i=1 and V_i+B_{i-1}+B_i=1 imply D_i=(T_i-B_i)/2 alternates and vanish for odd n. For even n, two exceptional alternating no-rung configurations generate one rail-antisymmetric Fourier mode n/Z_n. The remaining matchings correspond bijectively to matchings of an n-cycle, count L_n; correlation kernel B_d=F_{d-1}F_{n-d-1} obeys the cyclic recurrence 3B_d+B_{d-1}+B_{d+1}=L_{n-2}+F_n delta_{d0}, yielding the rational Fourier S-mode profile. Its lift into full edges has multiplier 4+2 cos theta. Differentiating the cycle matching partition polynomial yields the zero mode; positivity, monotonicity of g(t), and F_n bounds locate extrema. Independent full perfect-matching enumeration for every n=3..9 constructed direct 3n-by-3n covariance matrices and diagonalized them numerically, matching the complete nonzero eigenvalue lists, ranks and sharp condition formula within 1e-9. Finite tests corroborate the analytic all-n proof.
